listing.name: Library - OddiszCommons
listing.summary: Parts that several of my mods share, kept in one place. Install it when one of my mods asks for it. On its own it adds nothing you will notice.
listing.aiSummary: Provides shared code and a unified management interface for other mods by the same author.

description:
This becomes a standard library for my mods because I am duplicating code.

OddiszCommons

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
Parts that several of my mods share, kept in one place.
Install it when one of my mods asks for it. On its own it adds nothing you will notice.

Requires nothing.

Needed By
Omega Core Everywhere 1.2.3 and newer
Astral Ascension Renewed 1.0.2 and newer
Toolbox Economy Curves 1.0.3 and newer

For Modders
Add a page: Manage.addPage(modId, tabName, page) in onApplicationLoad, with a class that builds its own panel each time the tab opens.
Details and examples are in the README.

Compatibility
Safe to add to a game in progress.
Remove the mods that need it before removing it.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5)

License
This mod is under the CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with the code, without giving any credit to anyone.

Version log
0.2.1
Added the forum topic link for Version Checker.

0.2.0
Added a shared colony ledger that Omega Core Everywhere, Astral Ascension Renewed and Toolbox Economy Curves now use to keep, undo and clean up their colony changes before every save.

0.1.0
First version: a Manage button on the campaign bottom bar (shortcut Y) where Oddisz's mods keep their own pages, one tab per mod. Shares one button with Project Arondight, Captain's Quarters and Liminal when those are installed.
